spots.text: CLOAKROOM. Please retain your ticket. Items not collected are kept for ever.

secrets.name: Behind the Coats
secrets.text: Behind the coats on the south wall there is an arch, and behind the arch a passage the width of a coat, where somebody has been sitting with a lamp, waiting for their number to be called.

meta.label: The Cloakroom
meta.blurb: Coats, thousands of coats, on hooks as far as you can see, all of them left here by people who meant to come back for them. They are still faintly warm.
